import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0002.png')
# chair is brown (R > 70, B < 40)
chair_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 70)
y_c, x_c = np.where(chair_mask)
print('obs_0002 chair bbox: x=[', np.min(x_c), np.max(x_c), '], y=[', np.min(y_c), np.max(y_c), ']')

# Let's find chair feet contact y
# Look at the bottom of the legs
for col in [75, 85, 95, 115, 140, 145, 160]:
    rows = np.where(chair_mask[:, col])[0]
    if len(rows) > 0:
        print(f'col {col}: rows {np.min(rows)} to {np.max(rows)}')

# Let's find all columns where max row > 380
for col in range(np.min(x_c), np.max(x_c)+1):
    rows = np.where(chair_mask[:, col])[0]
    if len(rows) > 0 and np.max(rows) > 380:
        print(f'col {col}: max row {np.max(rows)}')
